scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@pageloom/core && npm run prepare:vendor --workspace=@pageloom/functions && npm run build --workspace=@pageloom/functions && npm run build --workspace=@pageloom/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@pageloom/core && npm run prepare:vendor --workspace=@pageloom/functions && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pageloom/functions && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pageloom/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@pageloom/core && npm run prepare:vendor --workspace=@pageloom/functions && npm run test --workspace=@pageloom/core && npm run test --workspace=@pageloom/functions && npm run test:automation
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,functions,firestore,storage
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build --workspace=@pageloom/web && firebase deploy --only hosting
